description: Comau backend API — manages users, products, categories, purchases, and more.

dependencyChains.description: Get purchase history for a user identified by phone number. First fetches all users, filters by phone, extracts userId, then fetches purchases for that user.
dependencyChains.triggerCondition: user identifies a person by phone number (not by ID)

dependencyChains.description: Get purchase history for a user identified by email. First fetches all users, filters by email, extracts userId, then fetches purchases for that user.
dependencyChains.triggerCondition: user identifies a person by email address (not by ID)

dependencyChains.description: Get purchase history for a user identified by name. First fetches all users, filters by name, extracts userId, then fetches purchases for that user.
dependencyChains.triggerCondition: user identifies a person by their name (not by ID)

apis.name: Get Device Status History
apis.description: Retrieves the historical status changes for a specific device from MongoDB. Supports filtering by edge, collector, device, time range, and optional status value.

parameters.name: edgeId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the edge device

parameters.name: collectorId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the collector

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the monitored device

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Optional status filter (e.g. running, down, connected, disconnected, )

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start timestamp for filtering history records

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End timestamp for filtering history records

keywords: It is only for specific device, not for all devices

apis.name: Get Edges Last Statuses
apis.description: Retrieves the list of edge devices along with associated collectors and monitored devices including their latest statuses.

apis.name: Get Last N Statuses
apis.description: Retrieves the last N status changes for an edge, collector, or device depending on the provided parameters.

parameters.name: edgeId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the edge device

parameters.name: collectorId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the collector

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the monitored device

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of recent statuses to return (default: 5, min: 1, max: 150)
